originalEntry.title: 30-second business explainer template
originalEntry.author: alex_prompter
originalEntry.description: A fill-in template for a 30-second, 5-scene animated explainer about your business as a single HTML page, played in the Claude chat and screen-recorded.
originalEntry.description_zh: 填空式模板：把你的业务做成 30 秒、5 个场景的单页 HTML 讲解动画，在 Claude 对话里播放后录屏。
originalEntry.prompt: Adopt the role of an expert motion designer. Build a 30-second animated explainer for my business as a single HTML page. 5 scenes. The customer's problem, what I do, how it works in 3 steps, one proof point, and my name at the end. Bold text, smooth transitions, my brand colours. My business [DESCRIBE WHAT YOU SELL, WHO IT'S FOR AND YOUR COLOURS]
originalEntry.prompt_zh: 扮演一位专业动效设计师。为我的业务做一段 30 秒的动画讲解视频，做成单个 HTML 页面。5 个场景：客户的问题、我做什么、分 3 步讲它怎么运作、一个证明点，最后是我的名字。粗体文字，流畅转场，用我的品牌色。我的业务是 [描述你卖什么、卖给谁，以及你的品牌色]
